description:
The <■□■□■> series is a body of work accumulated and refined over the course of a year. Each thin layer of paint is partially erased in the next stage of polishing. This process resembles a struggle between the painted and unpainted states, through which the remaining color is chosen. The decisions of painting and polishing rely on the unconscious, emerging from prolonged contemplation.

Furthermore, this work consists of eight pieces that are painted together until, at a certain point, they diverge—like an evolutionary branching in living organisms—starting to influence one another after the separation.

title: Abandoned surface ℏ 2022
description:
Even in a world of overwhelming complexity, we remain bound by a few simple laws — the speed of light that cannot be surpassed, the unyielding principles of thermodynamics. Though these conditions are few, they determine the shape of our world. Images are no exception.

<Abandoned surface ℏ> reveals a surface of helplessly exposed to sunlight over an extended period of time.
